description: This script generates machine summaries and reports for a build system, involving patch extraction, version comparison, and rendering reports in text or HTML formats.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Base class for report formats with methods for rendering and template retrieval.

classes.name: TextOverview
classes.description: Subclass of Format for generating overview text reports.

classes.name: HtmlUpdates
classes.description: Subclass of Format for generating HTML report updates.

methods.name: needs_update
methods.description: Determines if a version needs updating compared to upstream.

methods.name: safe_patches
methods.description: Checks if patches are safe based on their status.

methods.name: layer_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path to a specified layer.

methods.name: get_url_for_patch
methods.description: Constructs URL for a patch based on layer and local path.

methods.name: extract_patch_info
methods.description: Extracts patch information from a SRC_URI.

methods.name: harvest_data
methods.description: Collects data about recipes and machines, including upstream versions and patches.
